question: How satisfied are you with our product's ease of use?

feedback.comment: The interface is incredibly intuitive and requires no learning curve whatsoever.
I struggled to find basic functions and the navigation feels counterintuitive.
This is by far the most user-friendly product in its category. Everything is exactly where you'd expect it to be.
The initial setup was confusing and the tutorial didn't cover important features.
After using it for a week, everything became second nature. The design follows logical patterns.
I constantly have to refer to the help documentation to perform basic tasks.
The mobile app is particularly well-designed with thoughtful gestures and clear icons.
Advanced features are buried too deep in menus and require too many clicks to access.
The search functionality is instant and always returns relevant results exactly where I need them.
Error messages are unclear and don't help me resolve issues when they occur.
The consistent design patterns across all platforms make switching between devices seamless.
I often accidentally trigger actions because buttons are too close together.
The onboarding process brilliantly introduces features progressively without overwhelming new users.
Common actions require too many steps compared to competing products.
The recent redesign has made everything more accessible while maintaining all the power features.
I frequently get lost in the interface and have to start tasks over from the beginning.
Keyboard shortcuts are comprehensive and follow industry standards exactly as I hoped they would.
The dashboard is cluttered with too many options that I never use.
Contextual help appears exactly when needed without being intrusive or distracting.
